File.name: 01-00-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "We went on a date! The two of us went to Sakakino-chou,\nand we stopped by at Sakakino Hills for a while.\nI was really surprised to see how busy it was there."

File.name: 01-00-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's only morning, and you've already latched onto Saionji?
Yeah, yeah... you two sure are close, though.
Sheesh... I've told you before, you've got it all wrong.

File.name: 01-00-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's wrong? You've suddenly gone all quiet.

File.name: 01-00-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's with that serious face? Oh, I get it. I know what you're thinking.
You've got this mental image of 'forbidden love', like on those sappy variety shows, don't you?
Listen, you've got the wrong idea.
You think that I like you, don't you? Well, yeah, I do. As a friend...
but it's not like I'm thinking of making you my boyfriend or anything.

File.name: 01-00-B05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, you and Katsura-san seemed to be getting along so well that I just felt like teasing you a little...
Yeah! I'm sorry. Did I surprise you?
Don't worry, I'm not thinking of doing anything funny like taking you away from Katsura-san.
You just go ahead and play nice with her.
Speaking of which, it seems like your date went well, didn't it?
Did you hear that from Katsura?
You'll be okay without me from now on, won't you?
But if you make her cry, I won't go easy on you.

File.name: 01-00-B06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Who are you accusing of oversleeping?
Phew... well, actually, I was almost late.
Pft... what's that supposed to mean?
It wasn't because I overslept, okay?
I was listening to the radio, and suddenly, it was morning.
I told you, I didn't. You have to sleep to oversleep.
Haah... you stayed up all night?
Oh, you want to know about Katsura, right?
Hmn? What? What's with the super-confident attitude?
Heh... I made sure I apologized to her. Everything's fine now. Just perfect.
Yeah. When it comes down to it, I'm a guy who gets things done.
Ahaha... it's not that big a deal.

File.name: 01-00-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah, that's right. Now that I think about it, there's no way that Sekai likes me.
To think that I'd mistake that for love so quickly... it's embarrassing to even think about.
Now that I'm finally going out with Katsura, I've got to start thinking only about her...

File.name: 01-00-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And the reason that she's been helping me this whole time... it must be because...
...But if that's the case, then why...?

File.name: 01-00-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've really enjoyed these past few days that I've spent by her side.

File.name: 01-00-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've got Katsura. I'm finally going out with her... and what's more, Sekai was the one who put the two of us together.
The girl I had once admired so much is finally paying attention to me... just what am I thinking?

File.name: 01-00-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: About lunch... Katsura and I are going to the cafeteria to buy something, so you go on ahead.
What are you talking about? I'm not going.
Listen, you and Katsura-san have to eat by yourselves.
It'd feel weird if it was suddenly just the two of us.
It's not weird. That's what going out with someone means.
Stop saying 'but'! Come on, Katsura-san is waiting for you! Go, go!

File.name: 01-00-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I still think you should come too.
No! I told you, I can't come anymore.
If you don't come, I won't know what to talk about.
Kyah! There you go again! Stop pulling me like that!

File.name: 01-00-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've got to start eating alone with Katsura, don't I?
That's what going out with someone means, doesn't it?

File.name: 01-00-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah! There's somewhere I have to be, so I'll be going now. See you later!
I guess I've got no choice. I'll have to give up on her...

File.name: 01-00-D04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I thought I'd stay friends with you, even after I started going out with Katsura.
But we won't be able to eat lunch together like we always do, right?
I feel kind of restricted, not being able to eat lunch with my friend anymore.
Come on, if we're really friends, we should at least be able to eat lunch together, right?
Yeah, I guess you've got a point...

File.name: 01-00-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... don't get all embarrassed, now.

File.name: 01-00-D06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It sure feels hard... going out with someone.

File.name: 01-00-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... you didn't even say grace.
Sheesh... oh, your lunch is looking tasty as usual.
Well, Mom made it for me today.
In that case, it should taste great.
What do you mean, 'in that case'?
Haha... I'll be taking that omelette.
Sheesh... you're hopeless. Just look at the kind of guy he is, Katsura-san.
Oh, shut up. I'm going to eat some more.
Please have some of mine, too.
I bought it from the bakery in front of the station, but it's made daily with all-natural yeast, and it's very tasty.

File.name: 01-00-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Do you always have bread, Katsura?
Huh? Oh, yes. I buy it from the bakery in front of the station every morning.
It's made daily with all-natural yeast, and it's very tasty.
Oh, sure. You can have some of mine, too. It's just the daily sandwich from the cafeteria, though.
I mean... after class. If you've got nothing to do, why don't we go somewhere like we did yesterday?
Ah... but I have a student rep meeting today, too.
I... I see. But maybe you'll have some time left over like yesterday. I mean, if you do...
I was home late yesterday, so my father was angry with me. I have to be home early today.
We have a strict curfew at our house.
No, I'm glad that you invited me.
Do you have meetings every day?
Not every day, but there'll be quite a few up until the school festival.
N-no, there's no need for you to apologize. After all, it's a school event.

File.name: 01-00-E02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She says it's... um... because we're going out.
She's really making a big deal out of this, isn't she?
She's totally got the wrong idea.

File.name: 01-00-E03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai's acting strange... all of a sudden, she's refusing to come.
She's getting the wrong idea about this. We'd all be having more fun with her here.

File.name: 01-00-E04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Not really... but she's been acting strange.
She absolutely insisted on not coming. Maybe she doesn't like me anymore?
I'm sure that Saionji-san is just...

File.name: 01-00-E05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... look at the time. We should head back to class.
I've got to tell Sekai off once I get back to the classroom. You should talk to her if you see her too, Katsura.

File.name: 01-00-E06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You were about to say something, weren't you?
It's really nothing. Come on, we'd better go. Class is about to start...
Look, just tell me what you were going to say.
Huh? Oh, yeah. Sekai forced me into it.

File.name: 01-00-E07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Um... c-class is about to start.

File.name: 01-00-E08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: In that case... I'll help myself.

File.name: 01-00-E09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... but you don't have to if you don't want to.
Why are you two acting so reserved?

File.name: 01-00-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well? How was your nice, cozy lunch for two?

File.name: 01-00-F02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You should come with us tomorrow.
Huh?! What are you talking about?!
So I'm an idiot. Come anyway.

File.name: 01-00-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What is it? Why don't you just tell me?

File.name: 01-00-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She was about to say something... I wonder what it was?

File.name: 01-00-G01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's true that our date yesterday was kind of awkward... and we didn't really talk...
And she did say something about how she got in trouble for breaking curfew.
Maybe her dad said something like, 'I forbid you to go out with a boy like that!'...
No, wait. Calm down... would she really discuss her first date with her parents? She wouldn't, right?
But maybe things like that have been adding up, and now she doesn't like me.
In that case... maybe she was about to break up with me after all...
Either way, I should try asking her after class.

File.name: 01-00-G02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: One thing about Katsura is that she's just a little too quiet...
she's the type who's too shy to say what's on her mind.
Maybe she was trying to tell me something important, but found that she couldn't.
'Ko', huh... I wonder what she meant?
I guess I'll ask her after class, before her student rep meeting.

File.name: 01-00-G03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hmm... no, I should just forget about it.
There's no point in thinking too hard about it.
I'll catch her and ask her after class, before she goes to her student rep meeting.

File.name: 01-00-G04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Katsura-san, where were you at lunch today...?
Eheheh... I forgot to bring lunch, so I ate at the cafeteria.
The cafeteria...? If you'd told him, Makoto would have gone with you too.
Well, I thought I might be intruding...
Did something happen between you and Makoto?
Makoto told me that he apologized yesterday, and that everything's okay.
'Okay'...? Is it all really that simple?!
Maybe it's true that Itou-kun doesn't have fun when we're together...
but... just announcing that it's 'over' with a single word like that...
Hey, wait a second. I have no idea what you're talking about.
Hey... did Makoto tell you it was over?
Huh? But Makoto didn't say anything like that today.
That's because he likes you, Saionji-san...
Ah... look, hold on for a second here. Just how did you reach that conclusion...?
Even today, the two of you were leaning against each other, like l... lovers...
That was because I was drowsy from staying up all night and fell asleep.
Really, it's the truth. Makoto and I aren't like that.
Well, firstly, that lunch was just a misunderstanding. Let's forget about it.
Next, what's this about Makoto saying that it's 'over'?
Was that why you looked kind of down yesterday when the three of us had lunch together?
When did he tell you that?
After class, just before I went to the student rep meeting.
Ehh?! Did he really say that he was breaking up with you?! I haven't heard him say anything like that...
...So, he didn't discuss it with you after all.
The way I see it... you can say a lot about Makoto, but he isn't the kind of guy to just suddenly say goodbye.
It might just be a misunderstanding. What did he say?
'That's all I wanted to say,' he said... while smiling...
Maybe... this is all my fault.
That's not it... look, he and I were talking all by ourselves at lunch yesterday, right?
You looked bored, so I told Makoto to apologize to you.
You know how blunt he is... he's not good at speaking.
That's why... maybe he wanted to apologize for what happened at lunchtime,
but ended up causing a really big misunderstanding.
Even now, he still likes you.
He was insisting all throughout lunch that he wouldn't eat until you arrived,
so now that the boys are having P.E., he's probably exhausted.
Makoto really, really likes you, Katsura-san... that's why he seems nervous.
Yep. It's the first time you've gone out with someone too, isn't it?
You're both beginners. You're both too nervous to consider how the other person feels.
That's how misunderstandings and awkwardness tend to arise.
Want me to explain all of this to Makoto?
I'll... try talking to Itou-kun by myself.
I want to tell him how I feel... in my own words...

File.name: 01-00-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Nothing. I just noticed that you two seem to be getting along well.

File.name: 01-00-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess we do, don't we?
Stop reacting to every little thing like that.

File.name: 01-00-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: W-well, normally... I mean, we only just went on a date yesterday.
What are you getting all flustered for?

File.name: 01-00-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's wrong? What are you thinking so hard about?
Ah... no, I was just spacing out.
Are you sure you weren't thinking about how you don't get along?

File.name: 01-00-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You don't have to shout at me. I already know.
It was just a joke, you know.

File.name: 01-00-H05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: W-what's wrong? You're not supposed to go all quiet like that.
Ah, well... um... yeah. I, I'm sorry.
L-look, Makoto's always doing dumb things like this. You shouldn't take him seriously.
Makoto, you should apologize to Katsura-san too!

File.name: 01-00-H06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yesterday's date! You went to Sakakino Hills, right? How did it go?
Sakakino Hills is in Sakakino-cho, right?
Well, yeah. That's why it's called 'Sakakino' Hills.
Aw, sheesh... stop finding fault with everything I say.
Anyhow, Sakakino-cho isn't too far from where I live. Maybe it's because it's so close, but I've never actually been there.
Going by the Oohara Walker, it seems like an interesting place. So, how is it?
Interesting, you say? Well, there were these ridiculously huge buildings.
They've got all sorts of things like hotels and pools there, right?
Yeah. There are places like shopping malls and arcades. You know, like game centers.
Yeah, sure. Hey, I love those things in the arcades. What are they called again?
You know, the ones where you pick up a huge gun and go, 'Bang! Bang!'
Uh, wouldn't a normal girl go for sticker photos or UFO catchers?
I don't care. I always drag Nanami and Setsuna and the others into playing along with me.
Well, personally, I don't mind those games either.
Why don't we play one together next time?
Sure. Now, when should we go...? Wait, what about Katsura-san?
Ah... I don't really like games...
I guess there's no helping it, then. Let's go on our own.
Don't leave your girlfriend behind just to go to an arcade.
What are you talking about? You were all for the idea.
What about you, Katsura-san? What did you think of Sakakino Hills?
There was a very big book center... with a lot of books.
Wow, I see. You really like books, don't you?
Was there really a book center?
Yes, it was next to the CD shop.
We rushed past it because you said there was a CD you wanted.
Haha... I don't remember it at all.
W-what? There was a new release that I wanted.
Try not to repeat them today.
What are you planning to do today?
Are you going to go home together, or maybe stop off somewhere?
O-oh, right. Yeah. Shall we... go home together?
Ah... I've got another student rep meeting today, so...
In that case, I'll wait until your meeting is over, like yesterday.
Actually, because I broke curfew yesterday, my father told me to come home early today...
Your parents sure are strict on when you have to be home.
My mother isn't like that, but my father...
I see. Our family is just me and my mom, so I don't really know what it's like having a strict dad. Still, it sounds tough.
W-well, anyhow, I guess there's nothing we can do about it today.
Do you have student rep meetings every day?
Not every day... but the implementation committee will be busy until the school festival.
The school festival, huh? Setsuna was saying how tough it was for the committee, too.
Oh, come on, there's no need to be so apologetic. Right, Makoto?

File.name: 01-00-H07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai's right. When it's a better time for you, let's go somewhere together again.

File.name: 01-00-H08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: W-what is it? Why are you going quiet too, Makoto?
It's not uncommon for school events like the festival to make things inconvenient for a couple.
There's no need to feel bad.

File.name: 01-00-H09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... is it that time already?
Yeah. Let's head back to class.

File.name: 01-00-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You're really fired up, aren't you?
There's no point in worrying about it. I'm just going to ask Katsura straight out.
She seemed kind of down, like there was something she wanted to say. I'm concerned.
Maybe she was dissatisfied with yesterday's date.
Just kidding. I got an e-mail from her yesterday, and she was overjoyed.
Yeah, so give it your best.
Right. I'm off to do my best!
Sekai! Let's stop by Pure Burger on the way home.

File.name: 01-00-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There's something I want to talk to you about. Do you have a minute?
There was something you were going to say at lunch, wasn't there? What was it?
Come on, just look at you.
That's not the expression of someone who has nothing to say.
Hamaguchi is calling you. They're about to hold a student rep meeting.
I'll be right there. Itou-kun, I'll see you later...
Ahh... I'm sorry. Was there something you wanted, Katou-san?
Why are you in such a bad mood?
Do you and Katsura know each other?
Hmn? Did Katsura say something to you?
If she did, you want me to teach her a lesson? I'll make it cheap, seeing as how we came from the same school.
You're still playing basketball, aren't you?
Eh...? Y-yeah, I'm in the basketball club. Why?
The basketball club's already started running.

File.name: 01-00-J01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Can I talk to you for a second?
Go to a school festival preparation committee meeting, right? I know, but it'll just be for a second.

File.name: 01-00-J02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I want to apologize! I'm really sorry!
That's all I have to say. Thanks for your time!

File.name: 01-00-J03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ahh... well, you know, I was talking with Sekai the whole time, and we didn't get to say much to each other.
N-no, please don't worry about that. It's not like that at all...
But that's not how you looked.
I-it's not like that. It's not about the conversation... I, I mean... um...

File.name: 01-00-J05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Student rep meeting. Everyone's already there.
Ehh?! Ah, okay! I'll be right there! Itou-kun, I'll see you later...
You've already got Sekai, and yet here you are with another girl. I'm going to tell Sekai.
You idi- you've got the wrong idea!

File.name: 01-00-J06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's fine. I was the one who caused the wrong impression... besides, it's all my fault in the first place.
Do you have a student rep meeting again today?
No, there are no student rep meetings for today and tomorrow.

File.name: 01-00-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And then, Nanami confessed to this senior!
And then... what do you think he said?
Ah! Sorry, th-there's something I've got to take care of!
Sorry, I'm going home for today. See you tomorrow.

File.name: 01-00-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And then, on top of Hamaguchi's lectern...
These new chips are pretty good, aren't they?
Hey, Sekai, are you listening to me?
Sheesh... are you spacing out on us?
Ahaha... well, I did stay up all last night.
Ahh! You were listening to that radio show, weren't you? That one with the guy who has an afro...

File.name: 01-00-M00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you so depressed about?
But you've got that depressed look on your face.

File.name: 01-00-M01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: This has nothing to do with you.
You're right. This has nothing to do with me.
Yes, you're right... nothing to do with me.

File.name: 01-00-M02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Do I really look that depressed?
Yeah, totally. You're really looking down.
Want to tell me about it?
I don't know what I should do.
I just feel kind of tired, having to keep watching Katsura's expression like that.
Mmn... well, that's how it feels.
I'm sure it's not like that.
It's strange, isn't it? We're supposed to be going out, and yet I feel tired every time I see her...
And just having you listen to me complain like this... it's really a relief.

SetSELECT.sel1: 'I think you might be the one I like...'

File.name: 01-00-M03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I won't know if you don't say anything.
You won't know if I don't say anything... but I can't even ask you...
I don't really understand... but is this about Katsura-san?
Listen, do you want me to ask her for you?
I'll deal with this on my own.

File.name: 01-00-M04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I think you might be the one I like...
There's no way that could be true.
There is. I realize it now. Yesterday, when you kissed me...
I just wanted to tease you a little.
Maybe it was just a fluke that she agreed to go on a date with me. I don't think she really feels anything for me at all.
That's not true. Katsura-san said that she's always been interested in you.
You mustn't say things like that anymore.
Try thinking about how Katsura-san would feel.
Isn't she just as confused about how to approach you?

File.name: 01-00-M05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If it were you I was going out with, I wouldn't be suffering like this.
You're such an idiot. That suffering is what you call 'love'.
Love, huh... you really think so?

File.name: 01-00-M06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Katsura-san might be going through the same thing as you.
Just like you... she might be confused about how to approach you.

File.name: 01-00-M07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I shouldn't have been so pushy.
Yes. Will you listen to what it is?
Condition...? Well, if it means that you'll forgive me, then I'll do whatever I can...
I'll forgive you if you say it.
Ah... okay, sure. I'll call you 'Kotonoha' from now on.
Ufufu... in that case, I'll forgive you.
That was what I was going to tell you yesterday.
You call Saionji-san 'Sekai', and yet you call me by my last name... but I was just a little too embarrassed...

File.name: 01-00-M08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's kind of cold, isn't it?
About what I was going to say at lunchtime...
No... I want you to hear it.

File.name: 01-00-M09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So... she's going to break up with me after all...
But she did say that I could still call her...
No, wait! I get it! She's going to give me the 'Let's stay friends' line...
Actually, what I was going to tell you yesterday was...
Wah! Wah! I-I don't want to hear it!
I know I might have bored you on our date, but... you don't have to talk about breaking up all of a sudden...!
Ah... you mean that's not it?
I just... wanted to call you by your name, like Saionji-san does.
By name, you mean how Sekai calls me 'Makoto'?
Haha... w-wow, I really thought that... sure. Can I call you by your name, too?
Well, here I go, then... Kotonoha.
Oh, you don't have to use '-kun'.
Well, you can if you like.
Makoto-kun, huh... actually, that sounds kind of embarrassing... haha...

File.name: 01-00-M10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What I was going to tell you yesterday was...
I... wanted to call you by your name, like Saionji-san does.
I thought the reason that Saionji-san seemed so close to you was because of how she addressed you,
and that if I could do what she did...
Sure. In that case, can I call you by your name too?
Would I...? You mean you'd prefer it if I did?
In that case, I'll call you Kotonoha.

File.name: 01-00-N01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, I've got to deal with it on my own, huh...?

File.name: 01-00-N02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: 'Katsura-san might be going through the same thing', huh...
Is that really true...? If it is, I...

File.name: 01-00-N03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I like Katsura... don't I? I...
I like her, so... I've got to do something...

File.name: 01-00-N05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I won't force her to tell me anything she doesn't want to... but if I could only just talk to her...

File.name: 01-00-N06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll try talking with her tomorrow.
She might have changed her mind by then... I get the feeling she'll be willing to listen to what I have to say.
I should just sleep for today...

File.name: 01-00-N09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess there's no helping it.
I should just sleep for today...

SetSELECT.sel2: 'What did you want to tell me?'

File.name: 01-00-O03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: In the evening, remember? I think I made you angry.
Oh, no, t-that was... it was my fault. I'm... the one who should be apologizing.
I had the feeling that you wanted to tell me something important at lunchtime... I wanted to ask you...
...but I shouldn't have acted the way I did.
Anyhow, I wanted to apologize, so... I'm really sorry.

File.name: 01-00-O04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What was it you were going to tell me today?
U-um, I'm going to sleep now, so...

File.name: 01-00-O05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I just... you know... kind of wanted to hear your voice.
Sorry. I'm going to sleep now. I shouldn't have called.

File.name: 01-00-P00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder if he thinks I'm a strange girl now...

File.name: 01-00-P01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder... if he hates me now...

File.name: 01-00-P02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder if he means that he wants to stop going out with me...?
After all... we weren't really able to talk during yesterday's date...
And he only spoke with Saionji-san during lunch today, too...

File.name: 01-00-Q03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... can I call you again sometime?

File.name: 01-00-R00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sheesh... what's she getting all angry for? She looked like she was having fun when we were at lunch, too.

File.name: 01-00-R03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "You weren't talking to Katsura-san at all!\nShe looked really lonely, you know."
Weren't you the one who was talking to me the whole time?

File.name: 01-00-R04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "No matter what happens, you can't tell her, okay?!"
Makoto: "Yeah, I know."\nSekai: "No matter what happens, you can't tell her, okay?!"

File.name: 01-00-R05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Of course not, you idiot!\nI mean what happened with you yesterday!"
"I told you to forget about that!"
Like I could just forget about it...

File.name: 01-00-R08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "You weren't talking to Katsura-san at all! That's not right!"
Well, that was because I was talking to you during lunch, right...?

File.name: 01-00-R10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Katsura-san is a shy girl, so you've got to lead her out of her shell!"
"Katsura-san is a shy girl, so you've got to lead her out of her shell!"\nMakoto: You've got to be kidding...
"I couldn't help it. It's more fun to talk to you.\nPS: I'll go and apologise to her later. Happy now?"

File.name: 01-00-S00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I didn't see her. Maybe she overslept or something and missed our usual train...
I see. That's why you thought I'd overslept too.
Hmm... what should we do? Start eating first?
I'd like to wait... but if you're hungry, you can start eating first.
That's okay. I'm not hungry, after all... ah, but...
Hmn? Don't worry about it, just eat.
That's not what I mean. Listen, do you mind if I sleep for a while?
I stayed up all last night, remember? I was drifting off during class, too, but I'm still so sleepy.
The sunlight is nice and warm today, too. It might just be the perfect weather for an afternoon nap.

File.name: 01-00-S01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If Katsura comes and finds you asleep, she'd feel bad, right?
That's not true. Why, she might even say, 'Thy slumber art most wonderful to behold! Verily, I do grant thee a bounty!'
Like hell she would, you idiot.
Uuu... but I feel so sleepy.
Fwaah... it's no good... I'm going back to the classroom to sleep.
Well! I suspect I shall be hearing all about your nice, cozy lunch from Katsura-san in fifth period!

File.name: 01-00-S03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Mmn... I really don't think you... ah!

File.name: 01-00-S04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If Katsura sees us like this... I think there's going to be an undesirable misunderstanding.
I'm going out with Katsura, and yet...

File.name: 01-00-T00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Thank you so much for today. It seems that I have a tendency to act thoughtlessly and leave a bad impression on people - it's so embarrassing."
"But when I apologised to Makoto-kun, he forgave me right away. Oh, that's right. I was talking to Makoto-kun today, and he suggested that you should join us for..."

File.name: 01-1K-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It was all thanks to you, Sekai.
We went through all kinds of trouble... but because of you, Kotonoha and I finally understand how each other feels.
Ah, 'Kotonoha'. You're already on first-name terms. How indecent!
W-well, you call me by my first name, don't you?
It's okay for me to do it.
Well, anyhow, I'm really glad for you.
Fufuh... you'd better be grateful. Oh, that's right.
Here's a present for the two of you.

File.name: 01-1K-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She told us to eat on our own and went to the cafeteria with Kioura and the others.
She said, 'I've been apart from them lately, so I'm going to restore our friendship!'
The shop where Sekai works part-time over the summer has connections to a few cinemas. She said we could use them there.
That's just like her to give us discount coupons, when she could have just given us the tickets.
Ah, well, I mean... for example, maybe this weekend.
If that's no good, then maybe another day...

File.name: 01-1K-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... is now a good time?
Listen, thanks for the movie coupons.
Ahaha... sorry that they were only coupons.
That's fine, but... what movies would people normally go and see?
These coupons work for several movies... I'm not sure which one to see.
You idiot! I don't want to screw up.
You're someone I can count on for reliable advice about this sort of thing, right?
Am I, now...? Maybe I'll deliberately suggest something Katsura-san won't like.
Ahaha... well, what are they showing?
Let's see... there's this fantasy-ish movie called the Silmaril-something.
And then there's 'Triangle Love'... a romance, maybe?
Oh, yeah. There's a commercial for it on TV. It's a sappy romance about a love triangle.
Then there's 'Fighting Nemo'. It's a 3D animated movie about the fighting captain of a ghost ship... Is this a comedy?
Ehh? What's wrong with that? I like it.
Should I go with Nemo, then?
Which do you think is best?
I don't know. That's why I'm asking you.
It's not what Katsura-san wants to see...
That's not quite it either. Listen, what's the movie you want to see together with Katsura-san?
A movie I want to see with her...
H-hey, wait. You haven't given me any advice at all!
Well, you know, the movie itself isn't important.
It's the two of you sitting in the passionate darkness,
naturally holding hands and conveying your feelings through your grip...
Ahh! And then, your eyes look not at the silver screen, but at each other, and then... smooch!
Y-you idiot! I won't do that!
Yes you will. It's a date.
W-will I? Is that what you do on a date?
Maybe you'll give her a deep smooch.
Just kidding. It's up to you.
E-even if I wanted to, Kotonoha might not.
If she didn't, she would have turned you down for the movie.
Actually, it'd probably mean she doesn't like you. If she liked you, she wouldn't refuse you.
...You sure are easy to string along.
Fwaaah... I'm getting sleepy. You can work out the rest on your own.
Tsk. What's with her? Talk about uncaring.
A movie I want to see with her, huh...
The movie I want to see with her is...

File.name: 01-1K-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess that Silmaril-something film will do.
A fantasy movie sounds like a safe option.
Kotonoha looks like she reads a lot, so she might like that kind of thing...

File.name: 01-1K-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's a date, after all. We should see a romance.

File.name: 01-1K-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That Silmaril-thing seems a bit average, and Triangle Love is probably some cliched romance flick.
That'd just be way too embarrassing...

File.name: 01-1K-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It looks a bit childish, but Sekai did say that she liked it.
This ought to be fine, right?

File.name: 01-1K-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Maybe I'll pick another movie, even if the discount coupons won't work.
Let's see... 'Noise Base -Mobile Zombies Strike Back-'... what's this, a horror movie?
What else...? Ah, they're showing an adult movie, too.
'Radish Train -Pregnant Molester Train- / Hot Spring Inn Poster Girl -12 sisters compromised-
Female Teacher Katsugi's Lovely Dripping-White Ass Lesson'... a triple feature, huh.
Which movie should I see with Kotonoha?

File.name: 01-1K-C06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I can't decide on any of them... oh, I know.

File.name: 01-1K-C07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Let's make it the horror movie.
It's a scary movie, so she might go, 'Kyah!' in the dark and cling onto me.
Yep, the horror movie it is.

File.name: 01-1K-C08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yep, the porno movie it is.
It might be nice as a joke.
Maybe Kotonoha will go, 'Actually, I really wanted to see one of these!'

File.name: 01-1K-C09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hmm... I can't decide on any of these.
In times like these... I guess I'll have to rely on Sekai after all.

File.name: 01-1K-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry, did you wait long?
It's just about to start, so let's head in right away.
U-um... the movie we're watching today...

File.name: 01-1K-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, I think it looks interesting...
L-look at the notice over there.
Hmmn... 'Students and homosexuals not admitted. This is not a hook-up spot.' ...What's a hook-up spot?
Who knows...? In any case, I guess this means we can't go in.
Yeah... we'll have to give up.
In that case... let's watch Nemo.
'Fighting Nemo'. It's a comedy about this fighting pirate ship captain. Apparently it's pretty cute.
Still, Sekai said it was good, so I'm sure it'll be interesting.
Come on, let's go. It's not long before the screening time for Fighting Nemo.

File.name: 01-1K-E02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, well... do you... like this kind of stuff?
Yes, I'm quite a fan of splatter and horror movies.
It's not really a hobby to be proud of, so I usually keep quiet about it...
but it certainly is surprising to see that you like them too. Ufufu...

File.name: 01-1K-E03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ahaha... That Nemo sure is an idiot.
Ah! Look, there he goes again.
I-it's not that, but... it's just a little childish.
See? Anyhow, it's only just started, so we'll have to see how it turns out.
Maybe it was kind of a boring movie...
The two of you sitting in the passionate darkness...
Naturally holding hands and conveying your feelings through your grip...
You woke me up... didn't you?

File.name: 01-1K-E04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, it looks like a romance.
Let's see... 'Peter is introduced to Amelia by his childhood friend Chris.
Peter and Amelia start going out, and the trio's fun-filled school life begins...'
It's kind of like us, isn't it?
With Saionji-san as Chris, and me as Amelia.
That would make me Peter, right?
Well, Sekai and I aren't childhood friends... but I guess the relationships are kind of similar.
Look, Peter looks a little like you.
The two of you sitting in the passionate darkness, naturally holding hands...
Ahh! And then, your eyes look not at the silver screen, but at each other, and then... smooch!
Didn't you know? Peter and I are going out together.
No way! Then why did you introduce me to him...?
It's a little like us, isn't it?
N-no. I... I'm not going out with Sekai... it's completely different...
Ufufu... goodbye. Let's be friends even after we graduate.
I'm sorry, Peter's waiting for me. I'm going now.

File.name: 01-1K-E05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...I wonder what kind of movie this is?
It's based on a novel written near the end of the 19th century by an English language professor.
You sure know a lot about it.
Eheheh... actually, I recently read the book it was based on.
It was just before we got to know each other. It kind of feels like it's the book that brought us together.
I'm sure the movie will be interesting, too.
Do the dragons and the lord of the dead mean to harm us...?

File.name: 01-1K-E06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The two of you sitting in the passionate darkness, naturally holding hands...
Ahh! And then, your eyes look not at the silver screen, but at each other, and then... smooch!

File.name: 01-1K-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That was a fun movie, wasn't it?
I'm really glad you invited me today.
U-um, listen, we've still got time. If you like, we could... uh... um...

File.name: 01-1K-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: 'If she liked you, she wouldn't refuse you'... huh.
She completely refused me, didn't she?

File.name: 01-1K-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, hey, are you free after class today? I-
I have a student rep meeting today.

File.name: 01-1K-K03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "I'll bet you tried to force yourself on her and do something perverted, and now she hates you."
"How far can I go before it's 'perverted'?\n...I mean, what would make her hate me?"
"The first time didn't really work out, and the second time, she slapped me."
"Is even just holding hands enough to disgust someone?"
"Sure, in some cases. You've got to consider the time, place, people around you and stuff like that!"
"I don't think Katsura-san has\never held hands with a boy before.\nOther than at a folk dance..."
"So like I said, she was probably just surprised!"

File.name: 01-1K-K05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I always end up being saved by you, don't I?
Every time I'm stuck because I don't know how to approach Kotonoha... you come and help me out.
I really appreciate it, you know.
You're such an idiot. That's a total exaggeration.

File.name: 01-1K-K06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It was like that when I confessed to her, too.
Without you, I really might not have been able to do a thing.

File.name: 01-1K-K07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, you can thank me after you two make up.

File.name: 01-1K-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I want to talk to you.
I-I've got a student rep meeting...
We can talk after it's over.
And once it gets late, I've got to stick to my curfew...
Even a little while is fine.
I won't do anything like that again.
I didn't think you'd mind so much.
It's true that I wanted to hold your hand, and, well... I was thinking about things other than your hand, too...
and it wasn't all just a coincidence, but...
But I never intended to do anything you didn't want me to do.
That's why I want to apologize. Let's start over again.
I'll be waiting at the station... on the platform!

File.name: 01-1K-N00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That's not the way to the station.
I'm going home by bus today.
Why? There hasn't been an accident. The trains are still running.
It's just nice to take the bus once in a while...
Don't you want to take the train?
I-it's not that. I just felt like taking the bus today.
It's because you don't want to go to the station, isn't it?
He's been waiting for you all this time.
If that's the case, don't avoid him like this. Go see him, or I'll go and tell him for you.
It's not that I don't like him, but...
I'm scared. When it comes down to it, boys are just so...
He... tried to kiss me too.
So, he tried to kiss you.
I've always been no good with that side of boys...
Ever since the end of primary school, I've had the biggest bust in my class.
I really hated how it would stir up the boys and cause them to give me those indecent looks...
That's not how it is with Makoto, though.
I think that Makoto really cherishes you.
But things won't last if he's the only one who feels that way.
If you like him, then I think it's best that you face his feelings.
Hey, isn't that what being boyfriend and girlfriend is all about? The sharing of emotions and stuff?
If a guy's old enough to be interested in perverted stuff,
but has the self-control not to hold your hand, I think he's making an incredible sacrifice.
Well, anyhow, that's enough butting-in from me.
In any case, if you really don't like him, I'll tell him to end it because you two aren't suited for each other.
Don't worry, I can end this without making it look like it was your fault.

File.name: 01-1K-O00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Thank god. I was worried that you might not come... O-of course, I believed that you would, but... you know... haha.
L-listen, don't worry. I really won't hold your hand or... touch you anymore.
I promise never to do anything that you don't want me to do.

File.name: 01-1S-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I hear you two made up.
Ah, 'Kotonoha'. You're already on first-name terms. How indecent!
Come and have lunch with us today.
Kotonoha asked me to bring you along, too.

File.name: 01-1S-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You said we'd have lunch together...
Now that I think about it, I've been so focused on getting you and Katsura-san together...
that I haven't eaten with Setsuna and Nanami for a while.
I've got to go and salvage our friendship, or I'll end up being left out.
Yeah, so you two go on ahead and eat by yourselves.
I'll invite you both to lunch after I've had my fill of friendship.
Yep. You'd better be ready! Oh, that's right. Here's a present for you two.
What movie is it for? All it says is the name of the cinema, 'Radish Theatre'.
Some fantasy-ish movie called 'Silmaril-something', I think.
Well, whatever you watch, you'll get 200 yen off with this coupon.
Tsk... you could have just bought us the tickets instead.
If I had tickets, I would have gone myself.
Ahaha... well, I'm off to the cafeteria.

File.name: 01-1S-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I invited her, but she said she'd pass.
Oh, she's not doing it because of us. She said she's been eating with us all the time lately,
so she was going to restore her friendship with Kioura and the others.
Yeah. She was like, 'I'll be back once I've had enough of friendship, so you'd better be ready.'
I know how she must feel. She hangs around us so much that Kioura's group might be getting the wrong idea.
Kioura-san is the student rep from class 3, isn't she?
Yeah. I hear that she and Sekai have been\nfriends ever since they were little.
She only got to know Kanroji and Kuroda once she started school here,
but they're so close now that you'd think they've always gone to the same school.
Do you have any friends from your previous school?
Well, there aren't many people here from my old school, really... when it comes down to it, I guess it's just Katou.
You know, Katou from your class.
We're not exactly friends, but I guess you could say we're inseparable, since we've always gone to the same schools.
Still... it's not a nice way to put it, but she's more like a bad influence than a friend.
What about you? Is there anyone here from your old school?
Ah... there aren't many from my school either.
Saionji-san's friend Kanroji-san is from my school, but she was accepted on a sports scholarship.
I was always in the library reading, so I didn't have much contact with the people from the sports clubs.
Hmm... ah, what kind of books do you read?
Not at all. Things like fantasy...
With swords and dragons and stuff?
Come to think of it, there's a film like that coming out soon...

File.name: 01-1S-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "How was your lovey-dovey lunch for two?"
"Hey, there's something I want to ask you about."
"I asked Kotonoha out to see a movie this weekend."
"Shut up.\nLike I said, I've invited her,\nbut is there anything I need to pay attention to?"
"Don't kiss her if she doesn't want you to."
"Why not just watch a movie and do other normal date stuff?"
"I'm asking you because I don't know what normal stuff is."
"That's not something that can be taught."
"Listen! 'I'm having fun being with her!'\nJust go and do stuff which makes you feel that way."\nMakoto: Fun... huh.
"Oh, and one more thing! So long as Katsura-san has fun, the date is a big success!"

File.name: 01-1S-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry, did you wait long?
It's just about to start, so let's head in right away.
U-um... the movie we're watching today...

File.name: 01-1S-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...I wonder what kind of movie this is?
It's based on a novel written near the end of the 19th century by an English language professor.
You sure know a lot about it.
Eheheh... actually, I recently read the book it was based on.
It was just before we got to know each other. It kind of feels like it's the book that brought us together.
I'm sure the movie will be interesting, too.
Do the dragons and the lord of the dead mean to harm us...?

File.name: 01-1S-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That was a fun movie, wasn't it?
I'm really glad you invited me today.
I've never had a boy hold my hand before.
You know how in primary school, they'd force the girls and boys to hold hands at the folk dance because it's a school event?
Even that... I really hated it...
It's okay. You can hold it.
If you want to, that is.
If it's you, I think I can bear it.
So, she's forcing herself to bear it...

File.name: 01-1S-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "That sure was an interesting movie.\nHow did it feel to hold my hand?"

File.name: 01-1S-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Your date. You went on one yesterday, right?
It wasn't really a date. We just went to see a movie.
That's more than enough to qualify as a date.
I got an e-mail from Katsura-san last night. She said it was tough on her, but she had fun. Talk about hot!
Really? Did something go wrong between you and Katsura-san?
N-nothing like that happened. Everything was okay. It was a really fun date.
We saw a movie, ate and had fun talking.
I... I even held her hand. It was just like a proper date.
I see, I see... I shouldn't have bothered worrying, then.
To tell you the truth, Katsura-san said that she was a little confused because you were so aggressive,
so I was worried that you'd tried to do something perverted to her...
I know. You're not that kind of person.
I'm glad your date went well and that you two are getting along. Keep up the good work, young 'uns.

File.name: 01-1S-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Confused because I was so aggressive, huh...?
I only held her hand, but she hated it so much that she went and told Sekai.
Sekai tried to put a positive spin on it, but... somehow, I...
Is it really okay for Kotonoha and me to keep going out like this...?

File.name: 01-1S-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I think I've had enough. I might have bought a bit too much today.
Fufu... you could be right. There are still a few left in the bag.
They were having a one-day-only sale at the bakery in front of the station, so I bought more than I usually would.
Well, I'll have the rest for dinner. Mom's going to be home late, anyway.
It's always just the two of us up here on the roof, isn't it?
Hmn? Yeah, that's because Sekai's off with her friends.
That's not what I mean... none of the other students ever come here.
Yeah. That's because this place is normally off-limits to students.
Well, yeah... but Sekai went and got permission.
Yeah. Sekai got permission to use the roof by saying that
she wanted to revive the old astronomy club and having her friends sign up as fake club members.
That's why if Sekai stops hanging around here, we should probably sign up as astronomy club members too.
No, I like the stars. It'd be nice if we could really stargaze instead of being astronomy club members in name only.
Well, I hear that with the club dissolved, there's no equipment anymore.
If you want to see the stars, though, there's a planetarium at Sakakino Hills.
The wind's starting to pick up.
Ah, just a little while longer...
Look... we can't see the stars, but the autumn sky is beautiful, too.
The puffy clouds are so big and wide...
I... it's about time we go back to class.
You just said you wanted to stay for a little while longer...
I just remembered something I have to take care of.

File.name: 01-1S-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And now I've come back earlier than usual... huh?
You don't know? Wasn't she with you?
What are you talking about? Doesn't she always have lunch with you?
Not just 'used to'. Yesterday, last week and the week before, too.
Ever since the start of second semester, she's been having lunch with you.
Wow, it sure is cold outside. The wind's just going 'whooosh!'...
Huh? Setsuna and Makoto talking? That's something you don't see every day.
Sorry, I must have misunderstood. Forget I said anything.

File.name: 01-1S-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "I had lunch with Setsuna and the others."
"Kioura and the others were in the classroom, weren't they?"
"I went to the cafeteria just before you came back."
"Didn't you just mentioned how cold it was outside?\nThe cafeteria isn't outside, you know."
"I went for a walk outside too, okay?"

File.name: 01-1S-K02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That's because you're not telling me the truth...
Why does it matter where I have my lunch?
Because you want the three of us to eat together?
Listen, you've got to start getting used to eating with just the two of you.
No. The two of you are going out together, you know.
Oh, that's right. I've got to work today.
Don't you only work during the summer holidays?
They call me in temporarily when they're short-staffed. Well, see you later.

File.name: 01-1S-M00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Mmn... working both yesterday and the day before must have taken a toll on me.
That's no excuse for not answering your phone.
You called me? I didn't notice.
At least check your call history.
Sorry, I've just been so busy with work.
But thanks to that, I've got some income this month. Maybe I should be scoping out a winter coat...
Hey, there's something I want to ask you.
Ahh... mmn... I'm kind of sleepy from work. Ask me later.
Mnya mnya... I'm going to sleep until Yamamoto gets here...

File.name: 01-1S-M01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Now then, off to the cafeteria.
Doesn't Sekai usually hang out with you guys?
And you have lunch together too, right?
We don't like the idea of you going out with Sekai, okay?
Yes, we used to always have lunch together in first semester,
but she's been having lunch with you for the whole second semester.
Personally, I think it's fine for Sekai and Itou to be going out.
H-hold on for a second. I'm not going out with...
Don't give me that. You two have lunch by yourselves every day, don't you?
Wait, you mean this whole week...?
She's been with you all this week, too, hasn't she?
I don't know where the two of you are eating, or what you're doing there on your own, but...
Is it your fault that she's been looking so depressed lately? I swear, if you make her cry...
Itou. Forget about Hikari, just go and see Sekai. You're eating outside, right? You shouldn't keep a girl waiting.

File.name: 01-1S-N00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What should we do about lunch today? It's cold and windy. Should I buy something warm to drink?
There's... someone I've got to find.

File.name: 01-1S-O00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Outside... did she mean outside the school?
Ah, are you going outside too?
Me too. I'm sick of the bread from the cafeteria, so lately I've been going to the convenience store near the school gate.
Anyone would get sick of that food, with the same menu every day...
What? I'm not giving you any, okay?
Yeah, she was there at your usual meeting spot.
I know you're probably trying to keep it quiet, but it's so obvious that you two are going out.
Lately, I've seen Saionji waiting there for you every day.
At the bench in the courtyard. You can get a good view of it from the school gate.
Someone else is going to notice if you two keep meeting there.
Lucky for you, I'm just about the only one in our class who goes to that convenience store...
Hey, listen, if you introduce me to a girl too, I'll keep quiet about this... wh- hey!

File.name: 01-1S-P00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haha... does this charm even work...? It sure is hard to tell...
If I delete this, maybe Makoto will stop caring about me... and then...
What the hell are you doing in a place like this?!
You're eating lunch here?! Without telling Kioura and the others, or even me?!
Setsuna and the others... I couldn't tell them.
For some reason, they think you and I are going out. I ate with them for just one day, and they were all worried about me.
Had we fought? Had we broken up? ...Hikari was so angry, saying that she'd never approve of you and I going out...
Haha... even though we really aren't.
Besides, you said you and Katsura-san are doing well together, right?
I'd probably just be in the way if I go... so I tried to be considerate.
Still, I'm impressed you knew I was here. I'm good at finding nice little spots, you know. The roof, this place...
I've finally realized it. I love you after all.
You can't do this. You and Katsura-san are...
